incrementalReviews.note: The four class-overhaul integration daggers and the soul_stone painting, generated under woc-item-icon-v1 and owner-reviewed pass on 2026-08-10; the 2026-08-09 campaign review of the prior 817 files stands unchanged.

The two Proving Shore interact-prop icons, rendered from their own shipped world models (supply_crate.glb, marsh_bell_gallows.glb) by scripts/render_island_item_icons.mjs and owner-reviewed pass on 2026-08-17; the prior reviews stand unchanged.

Seven project-owned programmatic SVG placeholder bag icons were superseded by distinct OpenAI-generated paintings under woc-item-icon-v1. The replacements passed the deterministic icon and complete item-art machine audits and were visually reviewed as a family at the 512px masters and every canonical runtime, grayscale, circular-crop, multiview, and identity sheet size on 2026-08-26; all earlier item-art reviews stand unchanged.

The Lanternback Troll mount reins icon. The owner supplied the painted 624x624 master and directed its use for this item; it was downscaled to the 128px opaque woc-item-icon-v1 shipping format with no other change, and owner-reviewed pass on 2026-08-15. The 2026-08-09 campaign review of the prior 817 files and the 2026-08-10 review of the five class-overhaul integration additions both stand unchanged.

The Chimeglass Tortoise mount reins icon. Rendered from the shipped mount model (public/models/mounts/chimeglass_tortoise.glb) as a three-quarter head study, background keyed and flattened to the 128px opaque woc-item-icon-v1 shipping format, and owner-reviewed pass on 2026-08-15. Re-rendered on 2026-08-16 alongside the mount's lens-glow pass, which restyled the glowing lens pair the icon frames: same three-quarter head study, same shipping format, 3062 to 3784 bytes, owner-reviewed pass again on 2026-08-16. The 2026-08-09 campaign review of the prior 817 files, the 2026-08-10 review of the five class-overhaul integration additions, and the 2026-08-15 Lanternback Troll review all stand unchanged. Joined the 2026-08-09 record at the release/v0.42.0 sync of PR #3439 (which carries the troll of PR #3399), on top of the release side's 2026-08-12 through 2026-08-30 additions.

visualVerdict.summary: All 1071 shipping item-art files pass the visual contract: the current release-line record plus the Goblin Rocket Sled and Rallycart RXT mount icons already accepted in their parent records and joined in this v0.42 reconcile.

nonVisualContentWatch.reason: The art correctly depicts the runtime chest slot, but the player-facing name is Skullsmasher's Warbelt.
nonVisualContentWatch.recommendation: Resolve the content name/slot decision separately; do not repaint the chest icon as a belt while the item remains slot=chest.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The first repaint read as an empty white hood rather than a narrow circlet.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live silver circlet retains its full oval band and centerpiece at 128, 40, 28, grayscale, and circular size.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The first repaint contained several lines of accidental pseudo-writing.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live scroll uses only deliberate embossed circles, triangles, and diamonds and remains legible at every review size.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The prior shard was too thin and dark to retain useful visual mass at 28 pixels.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live celestial mineral has a broader silhouette and distinct blue-violet value separation at tiny and circular sizes.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The prior staff had a near-black, very thin shaft and head that collapsed at tiny sizes.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live lantern-cage head and brighter shaft remain distinct at 28 pixels and in the circular crop.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The upper half, lower half, and assembled quest reward used three unrelated object languages despite quest text saying the halves fit together.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live trio is one complementary cracked stone-and-bronze keystone set with a shared violet arch and crown motif.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The legacy source and first repaint depicted a tied salami roll rather than salted jerky.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live icon depicts dry, salted, fibrous meat strips with a compact readable silhouette.

resolvedDuringAudit.defect: The legacy source and first repaint depicted uncooked dough beneath a rolling pin rather than finished hardtack.
resolvedDuringAudit.finalEvidence: The live icon depicts a tied stack of baked pierced travel biscuits that remains readable at 28 pixels.
